reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Bedrock Server Manager
reauth_confirm.description: Enter updated credentials for this manager. Your monitored servers and options will be preserved.

init.title: Bedrock Server Manager Options
init.description: Choose which settings to modify for the Bedrock Server Manager at {base_url}.

update_credentials.title: Update API Credentials
update_credentials.description: Enter the new API username and password for the Bedrock Server Manager at {base_url}.

select_servers.title: Select Servers to Monitor
select_servers.description: Choose which Minecraft server instances managed by this BSM instance should be monitored by Home Assistant. {fetch_error}

update_server_interval.title: Set Server Data Polling Interval
update_server_interval.description: Define how often Home Assistant polls individual Minecraft server status and details (e.g., Running, CPU, Memory). Shorter intervals provide more real-time data but increase load.

update_manager_interval.title: Set Manager Data Polling Interval
update_manager_interval.description: Define how often Home Assistant polls global Bedrock Server Manager data (e.g., BSM OS/Version, Global Players List, Available Content). This is typically less frequent than individual server polling.

update_monitor_interval.title: Health and metrics fallback interval
update_monitor_interval.description: Live metrics follow the BSM sampling interval. This controls HTTP fallback polling and health checks.

update_event_filters.title: Event forwarding
update_event_filters.description: Choose events forwarded to the Home Assistant event bus. This does not filter internal state updates. Blank names forward all events.

error.invalid_server_scan_interval_range: Server update frequency must be between 10 and 3600 seconds.
error.invalid_manager_scan_interval_range: Manager data update frequency must be between 60 and 86400 seconds.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed with the provided credentials. Please check username and password. Details: {error_details}
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Manager API to validate credentials or fetch server list. Details: {error_details}
error.fetch_servers_failed: Failed to fetch the list of servers from the BSM manager. Check connection and BSM logs. Details: {error_details}
error.unknown_error: An unexpected error occurred. Check Home Assistant logs.

abort.credentials_updated: Credentials updated successfully. The integration will now reload.
abort.changes_successful: Options updated successfully. The integration will now reload.

send_command.name: Send Server Command
send_command.description: Sends a command to the specified Minecraft server's console. Target entities or devices associated with the server instance you want to command.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command to send to the server console (e.g., 'say Hello World').

prune_download_cache.name: Prune Download Cache
prune_download_cache.description: Deletes older downloaded server archives from a specified directory on the manager host, keeping a defined number of newest files. Targets a BSM manager instance.

directory.name: Directory Path
directory.description: The absolute path on the manager host where download files (.zip) are stored.

keep.name: Number to Keep
keep.description: (Optional) Number of newest files to keep. Uses BSM manager's default setting if omitted.

trigger_backup.name: Trigger Server Backup
trigger_backup.description: Triggers a specific backup operation (world, config file, or all) for the target server(s).

file_to_backup.name: File to Backup (for config type)
file_to_backup.description: Required only if 'Backup Type' is 'config'. Relative path of the config file within the server directory (e.g., 'server.properties', 'permissions.json').

restore_backup.name: Restore Server Backup
restore_backup.description: Restores a specific world or config file from a backup for the target server(s). WARNING: This overwrites current files! Use with caution.

backup_file.name: Backup Filename
backup_file.description: The filename of the backup to restore (e.g., 'world_backup_xyz.mcworld' or 'server_backup_abc.properties'). This file must exist within the specific server's backup subdirectory inside the manager's main BACKUP_DIR.

restore_latest_all.name: Restore Latest Full Server Backup
restore_latest_all.description: Restores the world and standard configuration files from the most recent 'all' type backup for the target server(s). WARNING: This overwrites current files! Use with caution.

install_server.name: Install New Minecraft Server
install_server.description: Installs a new Minecraft Bedrock server instance via the targeted BSM manager. Set 'overwrite: true' explicitly if you intend to replace an existing server with the same name.

server_name.name: New Server Name
server_name.description: Desired unique name for the new server (must be a valid directory name).

server_version.name: Server Version
server_version.description: Version to install (e.g., 'LATEST', 'PREVIEW', or a specific version string like '1.20.81.01').

overwrite.name: Overwrite Existing
overwrite.description: (Optional) If true, and a server with the same name exists, all its data will be deleted before installing the new one. Defaults to false.

delete_server.name: Delete Minecraft Server
delete_server.description: Permanently deletes ALL data for the target server instance(s), including its installation, configuration files, and all backups. THIS ACTION IS IRREVERSIBLE. USE WITH EXTREME CAUTION!

confirm_deletion.name: Confirm Deletion
confirm_deletion.description: MUST be set to 'true' to confirm you understand this action is irreversible and will permanently delete all selected server data.

add_to_allowlist.name: Add Players to Server Allowlist
add_to_allowlist.description: Adds one or more players to the target server's allowlist. This does not remove players already on the list.

players.name: Players
players.description: A list of player Gamertags to add to the allowlist.

ignores_player_limit.name: Ignores Player Limit
ignores_player_limit.description: (Optional) Sets the 'ignoresPlayerLimit' flag for the players being added. Defaults to false.

remove_from_allowlist.name: Remove Players from Server Allowlist
remove_from_allowlist.description: Removes specific players from the target server's allowlist. Player name matching is case-insensitive on the BSM API side.

players.name: Players
players.description: A list of player Gamertags to remove from the allowlist.

set_permissions.name: Set Server Player Permissions
set_permissions.description: Sets permission levels ('visitor', 'member', 'operator') for one or more players using their XUIDs on the target server(s). This replaces existing permission levels for the specified players.

permissions.name: Permissions List
permissions.description: A list of player permission objects, where each object has 'name', 'xuid', and 'permission_level'.

update_properties.name: Update Server Properties
update_properties.description: Updates specified server properties (e.g., 'max-players', 'difficulty') for the target server(s). Only properties allowed by the BSM API can be changed.

properties.name: Properties Dictionary
properties.description: A dictionary mapping server property keys (strings) to their new desired values (strings, numbers, or booleans). Refer to BSM documentation for allowed keys and value types.

install_world.name: Install World to Server
install_world.description: Installs a world from a .mcworld file into the target server, replacing its current world. WARNING: This is a destructive operation. The .mcworld file must already exist in the BSM manager's 'content/worlds' directory.

filename.name: World Filename
filename.description: The name of the .mcworld file (e.g., 'MyCoolWorld.mcworld') located in the BSM manager's 'content/worlds' directory. Can include subdirectories relative to 'content/worlds' (e.g., 'user_uploads/MyCoolWorld.mcworld').

install_addon.name: Install Addon to Server
install_addon.description: Installs an addon (.mcaddon or .mcpack) file into the target server. The addon file must already exist in the BSM manager's 'content/addons' directory.

filename.name: Addon Filename
filename.description: The name of the .mcaddon or .mcpack file (e.g., 'MyAwesomeAddon.mcaddon') located in the BSM manager's 'content/addons' directory. Can include subdirectories relative to 'content/addons'.

configure_os_service.name: Configure Server OS Service
configure_os_service.description: Configures OS-specific service settings for the target server(s), such as autoupdate or autostart (Linux systemd only for autostart).

autoupdate.name: Enable Autoupdate
autoupdate.description: Enable or disable the autoupdate feature for the server. This typically applies to Linux systemd service 'ExecStartPre' or a similar flag in Windows server configuration.

autostart.name: Enable Autostart (Linux Only)
autostart.description: (Optional, Linux Only) Enable or disable the server to autostart with the system via systemd user service. If not provided on Linux, the existing autostart setting may not be changed or could default to disabled depending on BSM API behavior.

add_global_players.name: Add/Update Global Players
add_global_players.description: Adds or updates players in the BSM manager's global player list (players.json). This is a global manager action; target a BSM manager instance.

players.name: Players Data
players.description: A list of player strings, each in "PlayerName:PlayerXUID" format. Example: ["Steve:123...", "Alex:456..."]. Input as a YAML/JSON list.

scan_players.name: Scan Player Logs
scan_players.description: Triggers a scan of all server log files on the BSM manager host to update the global list of known players. Targets a BSM manager instance.

get_plugin_settings.name: Get plugin settings
get_plugin_settings.description: Read a plugin's settings and validation schema. Supports response data.

update_plugin_settings.name: Update plugin settings
update_plugin_settings.description: Validate and persist settings for plugins that declare a settings schema.

list_tasks.name: List task outcomes
list_tasks.description: Return tasks visible to the selected manager account, including results and errors.

get_task.name: Get task outcome
get_task.description: Return a task snapshot with its status, result, error and revision.

update_server.name: Update server
update_server.description: Check for a Bedrock update and return its task identifier when queued.

restart_server.name: Restart server
restart_server.description: Restart each selected server and return the backend outcome.

reload_plugins.name: Reload plugins
reload_plugins.description: Reload plugins on each targeted manager and return the backend outcome.

set_global_setting.name: Set Global Setting
set_global_setting.description: Sets a specific global application setting on the BSM manager. Refer to BSM documentation for available setting keys and expected value types.

key.name: Setting Key
key.description: The dot-notation key of the setting (e.g., 'web.port', 'logging.level').

value.name: Setting Value
value.description: The new value for the setting. For complex values (like lists or objects), ensure correct YAML/JSON formatting if inputting as text. Simple values like strings, numbers, booleans can be entered directly.

reload_global_settings.name: Reload Global Settings
reload_global_settings.description: Forces a reload of global application settings and logging configuration on the BSM manager.

set_plugin_enabled.name: Set Plugin Enabled Status
set_plugin_enabled.description: Enables or disables a specific plugin on the BSM manager. Targets a BSM manager instance.

plugin_name.name: Plugin Name
plugin_name.description: The name of the plugin (filename without .py extension).

plugin_enabled.name: Enabled
plugin_enabled.description: Set to true to enable the plugin, false to disable it.

trigger_plugin_event.name: Trigger Plugin Event
trigger_plugin_event.description: Triggers a custom plugin event on the BSM manager, optionally with a JSON payload. Targets a BSM manager instance.

event_name.name: Event Name
event_name.description: The namespaced name of the custom event to trigger (e.g., 'my_plugin:custom_action').

event_payload.name: Payload (JSON)
event_payload.description: (Optional) A JSON object (as a string or dictionary) containing data to pass to event listeners.

add_server_ban.name: Add Server Ban
add_server_ban.description: Adds a ban to the server's ban list.

player_name.name: Player Name
player_name.description: The Gamertag of the player to ban.

xuid.name: Player XUID
xuid.description: The XUID of the player to ban.

remove_server_ban.name: Remove Server Ban
remove_server_ban.description: Removes a ban from the server's ban list based on the XUID.

xuid.name: Player XUID
xuid.description: The XUID of the player whose ban to remove.

reset_world.name: Delete Minecraft World
reset_world.description: Permanently deletes ALL world data for the target server instance(s). THIS ACTION IS IRREVERSIBLE. USE WITH EXTREME CAUTION!

confirm_deletion.name: Confirm Deletion
confirm_deletion.description: MUST be set to 'true' to confirm you understand this action is irreversible and will permanently delete all selected server world data.

enable_addon.name: Enable Addon
enable_addon.description: Enables an installed addon on the target server.

pack_uuid.name: Pack UUID
pack_uuid.description: The UUID of the addon pack.

pack_type.name: Pack Type
pack_type.description: The type of the addon pack (behavior or resource).

disable_addon.name: Disable Addon
disable_addon.description: Disables an installed addon on the target server.

pack_uuid.name: Pack UUID
pack_uuid.description: The UUID of the addon pack.

pack_type.name: Pack Type
pack_type.description: The type of the addon pack (behavior or resource).

uninstall_addon.name: Uninstall Addon
uninstall_addon.description: Uninstalls an addon from the target server.

pack_uuid.name: Pack UUID
pack_uuid.description: The UUID of the addon pack.

pack_type.name: Pack Type
pack_type.description: The type of the addon pack (behavior or resource).

reorder_addons.name: Reorder Addons
reorder_addons.description: Reorders installed addons on the target server.

pack_type.name: Pack Type
pack_type.description: The type of the addon packs to reorder (behavior or resource).

uuids.name: Pack UUIDs
uuids.description: A list of addon UUIDs in the desired order.

update_addon_subpack.name: Update Addon Subpack
update_addon_subpack.description: Updates the active subpack for an installed addon on the target server.

pack_uuid.name: Pack UUID
pack_uuid.description: The UUID of the addon pack.

pack_type.name: Pack Type
pack_type.description: The type of the addon pack (behavior or resource).

subpack_name.name: Subpack Name
subpack_name.description: The name of the subpack to activate.

discover_operations.name: Discover Operations
discover_operations.description: Discover current core and plugin OpenAPI operations.

call_operation.name: Call Operation
call_operation.description: Invoke an advertised operation using SDK contract validation and manager authentication.

upload_content.name: Upload Content
upload_content.description: Upload a world or addon from a Home Assistant allowed path.

get_application_diagnostics.name: Get Application Diagnostics
get_application_diagnostics.description: Collect a bounded backend diagnostic snapshot on demand.

get_subsystem_diagnostics.name: Get Subsystem Diagnostics
get_subsystem_diagnostics.description: Collect one subsystem with findings and freshness metadata.

get_diagnostic_history.name: Get Diagnostic History
get_diagnostic_history.description: Read retained diagnostic records with optional filters and cursor.

get_diagnostic_runs.name: Get Diagnostic Runs
get_diagnostic_runs.description: Read retained backend runs across restarts.

get_diagnostic_trace.name: Get Diagnostic Trace
get_diagnostic_trace.description: Correlate event, task and retained diagnostic metadata.

get_diagnostic_report.name: Get Diagnostic Report
get_diagnostic_report.description: Return the backend support report. Review before sharing.

compare_diagnostic_snapshots.name: Compare Diagnostic Snapshots
compare_diagnostic_snapshots.description: Compare two supplied snapshots without changing the backend.

before.name: Before
before.description: Snapshot to compare, or the preceding byte offset for log history.

list_application_events.name: List Application Events
list_application_events.description: List declared event names, descriptions and payload contracts.

get_event_activity.name: Get Event Activity
get_event_activity.description: Read bounded event delivery activity and capacity metadata.

shutdown_web_runtime.name: Shutdown Web Runtime
shutdown_web_runtime.description: Request graceful web-runtime shutdown. Administrator access and confirm: true are required. Restart from the host or service manager.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true to request shutdown.

get_log_history.name: Get Log History
get_log_history.description: Read a bounded log page for the authorized server target. A changed file returns HTTP 409; reload without before and file_id.

before.name: Before
before.description: Snapshot to compare, or the preceding byte offset for log history.

file_id.name: File Id
file_id.description: Identity returned by the previous log page.

get_application_log_history.name: Get Application Log History
get_application_log_history.description: Read bounded application log history. Administrator access required.

before.name: Before
before.description: Snapshot to compare, or the preceding byte offset for log history.

file_id.name: File Id
file_id.description: Identity returned by the previous log page.

list_audit_logs.name: List Audit Logs
list_audit_logs.description: Fetch backend audit history on demand, then filter exact action matches and return the latest limited selection. The backend currently fetches all records.

get_raw_properties.name: Get Raw Properties
get_raw_properties.description: Read server.properties comments and values without editing the document.

validate_server.name: Validate Server
validate_server.description: Validate the selected server using the existing backend contract.

prune_backups.name: Prune Backups
prune_backups.description: Prune old backups using server retention settings. Returns an accepted task.

reload_plugin.name: Reload Plugin
reload_plugin.description: Reload one plugin and drain its previous generation.

import_server_snapshot.name: Import server snapshot
import_server_snapshot.description: Import server snapshot. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Absolute path on Home Assistant inside an allowed directory. Downloads require a new filename.

recovery_key.name: Recovery key
recovery_key.description: Only needed for an encrypted archive whose key is not stored on the BSM host.

download_server_snapshot.name: Download server snapshot
download_server_snapshot.description: Download server snapshot. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Absolute path on Home Assistant inside an allowed directory. Downloads require a new filename.

list_server_snapshots.name: List server snapshots
list_server_snapshots.description: List server snapshots. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

create_server_snapshot.name: Create server snapshot
create_server_snapshot.description: Create server snapshot. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

inspect_server_snapshot.name: Inspect server snapshot
inspect_server_snapshot.description: Inspect server snapshot. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

recovery_key.name: Recovery key
recovery_key.description: Only needed for an encrypted archive whose key is not stored on the BSM host.

plan_snapshot_restore.name: Plan snapshot restore
plan_snapshot_restore.description: Review component destinations and warnings. Returns a task; its completed result contains the token required to restore.

recovery_key.name: Recovery key
recovery_key.description: Only needed for an encrypted archive whose key is not stored on the BSM host.

restore_server_snapshot.name: Restore server snapshot
restore_server_snapshot.description: Restore only reviewed components using the token from a completed restore plan. May stop and restart the server.

recovery_key.name: Recovery key
recovery_key.description: Only needed for an encrypted archive whose key is not stored on the BSM host.

dry_run_server_restore.name: Dry run server restore
dry_run_server_restore.description: Validate the selected components in isolation without changing the live server.

recovery_key.name: Recovery key
recovery_key.description: Only needed for an encrypted archive whose key is not stored on the BSM host.

manage_server_snapshot.name: Manage server snapshot
manage_server_snapshot.description: Verify, pin, copy, annotate, test recovery keys, or run a recovery drill. Returns a tracked task.

recovery_key.name: Recovery key
recovery_key.description: Only needed for an encrypted archive whose key is not stored on the BSM host.

get_backup_health.name: Get backup health
get_backup_health.description: Get backup health. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

get_restore_recovery.name: Get restore recovery
get_restore_recovery.description: Get restore recovery. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

recover_server_backup.name: Recover server backup
recover_server_backup.description: Recover server backup. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

download_backup_recovery_report.name: Download backup recovery report
download_backup_recovery_report.description: Download backup recovery report. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

prepare_backup_copy.name: Prepare backup copy
prepare_backup_copy.description: Prepare backup copy. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

recovery_key.name: Recovery key
recovery_key.description: Only needed for an encrypted archive whose key is not stored on the BSM host.

cleanup_backup_destination.name: Cleanup backup destination
cleanup_backup_destination.description: Cleanup backup destination. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

list_backup_keys.name: List backup keys
list_backup_keys.description: List backup keys. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

rotate_backup_key.name: Rotate backup key
rotate_backup_key.description: Rotate backup key. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

list_schedules.name: List schedules
list_schedules.description: List schedules. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

save_schedule.name: Save schedule
save_schedule.description: Save schedule. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

configuration.name: Configuration
configuration.description: Schedule fields: task, server_name, time, IANA timezone, weekdays (Monday=0), enabled, catch_up, stagger_minutes, options.

delete_schedule.name: Delete schedule
delete_schedule.description: Delete schedule. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

get_diagnostic_activity.name: Get diagnostic activity
get_diagnostic_activity.description: Get diagnostic activity. Uses the live backend contract and supports response data.

control_schedule.name: Control schedule
control_schedule.description: Queue a run or retry, or pause/resume a schedule. Immediate work uses the existing run history; an optional revision rejects stale controls.
